thread:
Anna M: Quick follow-up from the RFC sync — can we agree next steps for decoupling precision profiles from model manifests? TL;DR: move profiles to a registry + runtime compat shim.
Mateo R: +1. Runtime needs to accept a profile reference (profile_id) separate from model artifact. Lookup with a fallback chain: tenant override -> profile registry -> model-embedded legacy profile.
Priya S: Product note: customers expect per-tenant overrides + audit trail. Console should show both 'declared profile' and 'effective profile' (with reason).
Jordan T: Ops question: how long do we support model-embedded profiles? We need a migration window. I'd vote for 6 months minimum with feature-flag to prefer registry.
Ravi K: SRE perspective: we must emit per-profile telemetry (degscore, regeneration rate, latency/cost delta). Without that we can't detect regressions fast enough.
Mateo R: Proposal for wire: set header `X-Precision-Profile: profile:v2/fp8-balanced` or `X-Precision-Profile: profile:id/<uuid>`; runtime does lookup: 
```
def resolve_profile(req):
    if req.header('X-Precision-Profile'):
        return registry.lookup(req.header)
    if tenant.has_override(req.tenant):
        return tenant.override
    return model.artifact.profile # legacy
```
Fallback semantics: if lookup fails, log and fall back to model artifact.
Anna M: Also add to profile metadata: `quality_budget` (int tokens) and `regression_tolerance` (0-100) so runtime can make informed degrade decisions.
eng_qa_bot: shadow-job created: quant-profile-shadow-2024-04-12 (runs nightly against 10% traffic; reports per-profile regression counts)
Mateo R: Runtime impact: small change to request path + a cache for profile metadata (TTL 60s). Need to ensure bootstrapping order for private deployments (control plane vs. edge).
Priya S: Console: we should show effective profile, last-eval timestamp, and a one-click revert to model-embedded profile for customer safety. Also add a 'preview as tenant' mode.
Jordan T: Ops action: I'll draft migration runbook — steps for (1) enable registry read-only; (2) opt-in tenants; (3) gradual flip; (4) deprecate embedding.
Ravi K: I'll add telemetry events: `profile.resolve`, `profile.fallback`, `profile.regression_detected` with tags: profile_id, tenant_id, model_id, canary_tag. We should also surface alerts when regressions exceed `regression_tolerance`.
Anna M: Action items recap: Mateo implement lookup + cache prototype; Jordan draft runbook; Ravi wire telemetry & alerts; Priya update Console mocks; Anna will write RFC update with API spec and migration timeline.
Mateo R: On it — prototype ETA: end of week. I'll push a proof-of-concept branch and tag @eng-runtime.
Priya S: Can we also add a per-profile `compat_list` (models/ops that the profile has been validated against)? Product wants that visible to customers.
Anna M: Good idea — include `compat_list` and `validation_date` in metadata.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary/profiles-registry-prototype -> tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
Jordan T: :thumbsup: will sync with infra on DNS/ACL for private installs.
Anna M: I'll write the RFC update now and post link here when ready. Summary feels safe: declarative registry, tenant overrides, 6-month migration window, telemetry gates.
Mateo R: Quick note: edge case — long-running KV cache with older profile -> need eviction on profile update. Will add `profile.version` and `update_hook` for caches.
Anna M: Nice. That should cover most TODOs. Thanks everyone.
